info.name: UBHR Recruitment Portal - D365 F&O contract examples
info.description: Six JSON custom-service operations for UBHRPortalServiceGroup/UBHRPortalService. Import into Postman and configure variables locally. All sample identity, contact, document and AI values are fictional. An access token is intentionally not included; acquire an Entra client-credentials token locally using scope <F&O resource URL>/.default, then store it only as a local/sensitive accessToken variable. Do not export tokens or client secrets. getOpenRequirements uses the integration user's default company, which must match company. Run submitApplication before evaluation/read requests; its test stores the returned ApplicationId. The example blob reference must be replaced with a real private object before testing download or the complete portal workflow. These are contract fixtures, not evidence of an executed live F&O request.
